summary: This bill directs federal agencies, including the Attorney General and Secretary of Homeland Security, to develop a strategy within 180 days to improve federal investigations of organized retail crime by enhancing information sharing among agencies and with state/local law enforcement and the retail industry, and requires a report to Congress on this strategy.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses entirely on improving federal investigations and coordination to combat organized retail crime, which involves theft, fraud, and embezzlement. It aims to strengthen law enforcement's ability to prosecute these crimes by enhancing information sharing and cooperation, thus promoting stricter justice and stronger policing against these specific offenses.
